subject: Intro: Redwood discovery + scheduling with CloudVera
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.p@cloudvera.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood discovery + scheduling with CloudVera

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the intro earlier today. I’d like to schedule a 45–60 minute discovery call next week so we can:
- Walk through your primary inference workloads and SLAs
- Cover security/requirements (SOC2, data residency) you flagged
- Run through a short product demo focused on latency/cost controls

Attendees we typically bring: AE (me), Solutions Engineer (So— I’ve CC’d Soojin), and a Solutions/CS rep (Marissa) for procurement/logistics.

Proposed windows (all in PT):
- Tue 10/20, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 10/21, 11:00–12:00

If those don’t work, share two slots that do and we’ll follow up with a calendar invite. I’ve also attached a short demo ops checklist so your security/procurement folks know what evidence we’ll reference.

Attachments: redwood-demo-ops-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Michael

Can we make the call 60 minutes instead of 45? Luis will want to discuss retention and KV cache concerns.

—Asha

> Thanks Michael — Tue 10/20 at 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll loop in Luis (engineering lead) for the deep technical bits; he prefers a 60-minute slot. Also adding procurement alias so they see the evidence checklist.
>

Absolutely — 60 minutes is fine. I’ve proposed the 10/20 10:00–11:00 PT slot on our side and will send a calendar invite once we confirm. Soojin, can you plan for the extended technical portion (30–35 minutes) focused on runtime, caching, and quantization recommendations?

Marissa — can you keep procurement looped for DocuSign and the standard SOW cadence? I’ve attached the checklist again and a short security evidence spreadsheet that lists typical items customers ask for (SOC2/ISO certs, data deletion policy, audit log samples).

Attachments: redwood-demo-ops-checklist.pdf; security-evidence-request.xlsx

Thanks —
—Michael

Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10m: Intros and success criteria (Asha)
- 10–35m: Technical deep dive (So— Soojin walk through runtime, KV cache, and IP allowlist)
- 35–50m: Demo: latency/cost controls + dedicated vs hosted options

Pre-reads attached: security-evidence-request.xlsx (spreadsheet listing common evidence), redwood-demo-ops-checklist.pdf (short ops checklist).
